svg.title: Encounter — a circuit of urban perception
svg.desc: A conceptual synthesizer circuit. Ho Chi Minh City feeds branching paths through attention, listening, selection, exchange, participation and sequence. Projects tune these connected conditions. Sensory experience informs perception; return routes allow material to be encountered again.

g.text: A conceptual model of urban perception
The city remains. Projects tune the conditions through which it is encountered.
Conceptual model · Relationships, not measured effects. Proposed exhibition instrument.
